tutorial.history.title: Umlando wengxoxo
tutorial.history.body: Lona umlando wakho wengxoxo yokuhumusha. Izingxoxo zangaphambilini ze-AVNIVO nokuhumusha kulondolozwe lapha. Ungaphinda uvule futhi ubuyekeze izingxoxo zangaphambilini noma uqale entsha.
tutorial.settings.title: Izilungiselelo
tutorial.settings.body: Enza ngendlela oyifisayo ukuthi umhumushi usebenza kanjani lapha. Izilungiselelo eziku-inthanethi zifaka ukudlalwa kwenkulumo, amazwi, amathoni nezitayela. Izilungiselelo ezingaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi zibonisa ukuqashelwa kwenkulumo okulandekayo, ukuhumusha kanye namamojula okudlala inkulumo kanye nesimo sawo. Izici zincike kwimodi ekhethiwe namamojula afakiwe.
tutorial.microphone.title: Imakrofoni
tutorial.microphone.body: Sebenzisa imakrofoni ukuhumusha inkulumo. Khetha izilimi zakho, thepha imakrofoni futhi ukhulume ngokujwayelekile. Ukuqashelwa kwenkulumo kuncike kumodi ekhethiwe. Imvume yemakrofoni yesiphequluli ingadingeka.
tutorial.online.title: Imodi eku-inthanethi
tutorial.online.body: Le nkinobho ikhetha ukuhumusha okune-inthanethi. Imodi eku-inthanethi ingasebenzisa ukubonwa kwenkulumo yamafu nezinsizakalo zokuhumusha. Uxhumano lwe-inthanethi nokufinyelela kumasevisi kuyadingeka. Uhlelo lokusebenza okwamanje luvula ngemodi ye-inthanethi.
tutorial.offline.title: Imodi engaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi
tutorial.offline.body: Le nkinobho ikhetha imodi ehloselwe ukusetshenziswa ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Landa amamojula olimi nenkulumo adingekayo kusenesikhathi. Izilimi ezitholakalayo nezici zincike kumamojula afakiwe. Thepha okuthi Qonda ukuze uqedele isingeniso futhi uvule uhlelo lokusebenza.
